# diffr

A tool to display unified diffs with refined, word-level highlighting to ease code review.

Usage

- Read a diff from stdin and write an enhanced diff to stdout. Example:

  git show HEAD | diffr

- Integrate with git by setting diffr as your pager or diffFilter. Example configuration:

  [core]
      pager = diffr | less -R
  [interactive]
      diffFilter = diffr

You can also set these from the command line:

  git config --global core.pager 'diffr | less -R'
  git config --global interactive.difffilter diffr

Options and flags

- --colors: customize the colors used for added/removed and refined sections.
- --line-numbers: display line numbers for each hunk.

Examples

- One-off usage:

  git show HEAD | diffr

- Customize colors (example):

  diffr --colors refine-removed:background:200,0,0:foreground:white:bold

Screenshots and examples may be included in the repository to show how the output looks.

---
title: DIFFR
section: 1
header: User Manual
footer: diffr 1.5.0
date: April 14, 2023

# NAME
diffr - adds word-level diff on top of unified diffs

# SYNOPSIS
**diffr** [**\-\-colors** *\<color_spec\>*] [**\-\-line-numbers** \<compact|aligned\>]

diff -u <file1> <file2> | **diffr** [OPTIONS]

git show | **diffr** [OPTIONS]

# DESCRIPTION
**\-\-colors** *\<color_spec\>*
    Configure color settings for console ouput.

    There are four faces to customize:
    +----------------+--------------+----------------+
    |  line prefix   |      +       |       -        |
    +----------------+--------------+----------------+
    | common segment |    added     |    removed     |
    | unique segment | refine-added | refine-removed |
    +----------------+--------------+----------------+

    The customization allows
    - to change the foreground or background color;
    - to set or unset the attributes 'bold', 'intense', 'underline';
    - to clear all attributes.

    Customization is done passing a color_spec argument.
    This flag may be provided multiple times.

    The syntax is the following:

    color_spec = face-name + ':' + attributes
    attributes = attribute
               | attribute + ':' + attributes
    attribute  = ('foreground' | 'background') + ':' + color
               | (<empty> | 'no') + font-flag
               | 'none'
    font-flag  = 'italic'
               | 'bold'
               | 'intense'
               | 'underline'
    color      = 'none'
               | [0-255]
               | [0-255] + ',' + [0-255] + ',' + [0-255]
               | ('black', 'blue', 'green', 'red',
                  'cyan', 'magenta', 'yellow', 'white')

    For example, the color_spec

        'refine-added:background:blue:bold'

    sets the color of unique added segments with
    a blue background, written with a bold font.

**\-\-line-numbers** \<compact|aligned\>
    Display line numbers. Style is optional.
    When style = 'compact', take as little width as possible.
    When style = 'aligned', align to tab stops (useful if tab is used for indentation). [default: compact]

**-h**, **\-\-help**
        Prints help information

**-V**, **\-\-version**
        Prints version information

Nathan Moreau \<nathan.moreau@m4x.org\>

# LICENSE
The MIT License (MIT)

diffr $VERSION
Nathan Moreau <nathan.moreau@m4x.org>

diffr adds word-level diff on top of unified diffs.
word-level diff information is displayed using text attributes.

import subprocess, random, os, json

    if not d: continue
    o=subprocess.run(['/workspace/executable'],input=d,capture_output=True,text=True)
    cases.append({'input':d,'output':o.stdout,'rc':o.returncode})
json.dump(cases,open('corpus.json','w'))
print(len(cases))
EOF

def segs(line):
    # line like: <esc0m>? (esc-attrs text esc0m)*

def segs(line):
    # line like: <esc0m>? (esc-attrs text esc0m)*
    parts=line.split('\x1b[0m')

from model4 import *

def parse_unified(text):
    lines=text.split('\n')
    if lines and lines[-1]=='': lines.pop()
    items=[]  # ('hunk', [list of (kind, content)]) or ('plain', line)
    i=0
    cur=None
    while i<len(lines):
        L=lines[i]

import sys,json
sys.path.insert(0,'.')
from model4 import *

def parse_unified(text):
    lines=text.split('\n')
    if lines and lines[-1]=='': lines.pop()
    items=[]
    i=0
    while i<len(lines):
        L=lines[i]
        if L.startswith('--- ') or L.startswith('+++ '):
            items.append(('plain',L)); i+=1; continue
        if L.startswith('@@'):
            hdr=L; i+=1
            body=[]
            while i<len(lines):
                L2=lines[i]
                if L2.startswith('--- ') or L2.startswith('+++ ') or L2.startswith('@@'):
                    break
                if L2 and L2[0] in '-+ ':
                    body.append((L2[0], L2[1:])); i+=1
                else:
                    break
            items.append(('hunk',hdr,body))
            continue
        items.append(('plain',L)); i+=1
    return items

def render_items(items, difffn=lcs_dp):
    out=[]
    for kind,hdr,body in items:
        if kind=='plain':
            out.append(DEFAULT+hdr+RESET); continue
        out.append(DEFAULT+hdr+RESET)
        j=0; n=len(body)
        while j<n:
            k0,j0,bodyline = body[j]
            if k0==' ':
                out.append(DEFAULT+' '+bodyline+RESET); j+=1; continue
            rr=[]; aa=[]
            while j<n and body[j][0]=='-': rr.append(body[j][1]); j+=1
            while j<n and body[j][0]=='+': aa.append(body[j][1]); j+=1
            leads_r,toks_r=tokenize_lines(rr)
            leads_a,toks_a=tokenize_lines(aa)
            ops=difffn([t[0] for t in toks_r],[t[0] for t in toks_a])
            segr,sega=build(leads_r,toks_r,len(rr),leads_a,toks_a,len(aa),ops)
            for k,c in enumerate(rr):
                out.extend(render_block_line('R','-',leads_r[k],segr[k],c))
            for k,c in enumerate(aa):
                out.extend(render_block_line('A','+',leads_a[k],sega[k],c))
    return '\n'.join(out)+'\n'

def fwd_leftmost(a,b):
    """greedy leftmost LCS: prefer advancing in b (Add) if it preserves LCS, else advance in a"""
    n=len(a); m=len(b)
    L=suffix_lcs(a,b)
    ops=[]; i=0; j=0
    while i<n and j<m:
        if a[i]==b[j]: ops.append('C'); i+=1; j+=1; continue
        if L[i][j+1]==L[i][j]: ops.append('A'); j+=1
        else: ops.append('R'); i+=1
    while i<n: ops.append('R'); i+=1
    while j<m: ops.append('A'); j+=1
    return ops

def fwd_leftmost(a,b):
    """greedy leftmost LCS: prefer advancing in b (Add) if it preserves LCS, else advance in a"""
    n=len(a); m=len(b)
    L=suffix_lcs(a,b)
    ops=[]; i=0; j=0
    while i<n and j<m:
        if a[i]==b[j]: ops.append('C'); i+=1; j+=1; continue
        if L[i][j+1]==L[i][j]: ops.append('A'); j+=1
        else: ops.append('R'); i+=1
    while i<n: ops.append('R'); i+=1
    while j<m: ops.append('A'); j+=1
    return ops

def segs(line):
    parts=line.split('\x1b[0m'); out=[]

def structcmp(A,B):

    for (fa,ta),(fb,tb) in zip(A,B):

        ka,kb=kind(fa),kind(fb)
        if ka!=kb and 'W' not in (ka,kb): return False
